answer: A shared reef of rotating hash challenges is drawn from a public orchard of seeds. Each new identity must solve one unique vertex before it gains weight; difficulty rises with recent joins from the same subnet. An attacker seeking N sybils pays N independent vertex solves whose total work grows quadratically: every solve burns one scarce orchard seed and advances the reef difficulty for the next. Honest agents amortize a single solve across epochs; each fake identity restarts the full escalating cost.
